keyframe_review.note: 271-265, 73.8 k km2 in 249 vertices: the Greek poleis outside the named states, in 12 clusters (Languedoc and Provence coast 47 cells, west Pontic coast 37, Pontic Anatolia 36, Crimea 23, Olbia and the Bug-Dnieper coast 23, Caria 20, Crete 15, Valencia coast 14, Syracuse 14, Propontis 11, Aetolian-Acarnanian coast 8, Azov 8, Rhodes 5). Not a state: the Greek colonisation page has colonies 'usually independent of the metropolis and had their own governance'. Carved out, each with a dossier: Syracuse (the Hiero II page: 'When Pyrrhus left Sicily (275 BC) the Syracusan army and citizens appointed Hiero commander-in-chief'; king 265), the island of Rhodes (one territory since 408 on the Rhodes page) and Massalia's colonies. The rest is unverified: page budget, except Chersonesos, which the Chersonesos page describes as a self-governing polis with northwest Crimea incorporated, independent to c. 110. The infobox check is void: the Greek colonisation page has no area.

keyframe_review.note: 230-226, 82.0 k km2: 47 cells are added, of which Laconia is 30, the coast at Sukhumi (Dioscurias) 11, Elis 5 and a few on the Propontis and at Chios. Laconia is Sparta's under Cleomenes III ('Cleomenes ascended the throne of Sparta in 235 BC'; 'In 229 BC, the cities of Tegea, Mantinea, Caphyae and Orchomenus ... joined Sparta'; the page never names Laconia or Messenia as Spartan holdings in any sentence), so it leaves the aggregate. The Colchian, Elean and Propontic additions are unverified: page budget.

notes: WHAT THIS ROW IS: Cliopatria's 'Greek Colonies' (-271..-226, six shapes, 70-83 k km2) is not a state. It is the same aggregate of independent Greek poleis and colonies that the 'Greek City-States' row carries to 272 and again from 225, under another Name for 46 years; the Greek colonisation page treats colonies as 'independent poleis' that 'did not involve demanding tribute or laying claim to the hinterland'. The group eu-01 dossier greek-city-states carries these years in a bridging keyframe (greek-city-states_-271, pieces -271 and -257) and asks eu-02 whether to write this dossier; this one reviews the six Cliopatria shapes under their own ids with the same carve-outs. If the orchestrator keeps one aggregate, merge this dossier into greek-city-states and drop one of the two. Type 'state' (not 'umbrella', which would turn the land grey) as in greek-city-states; no capital. Dates 271 and 226 are Cliopatria's. Carved out as states with their own dossiers: Syracuse (Hiero II, syracuse), the island of Rhodes (rhodes, from 408), Massalia's colonies (massalia), Epirus from 247 (kingdom-of-epirus) and Laconia from 230 (peloponnesian-league). Not carved: Caria, whose 20 cells in 271 shrink to 5 by 247 for no reason any page gives (the Rhodian Peraia page has Rhodes keep 'a portion of its old domains in Asia until 39 BC' without a 3rd-century extent), nor the Pontic coast east of Sinope, which may overlap kingdom-of-pontus (-281..67). Left unverified: page budget (five pages): the west Pontic cities (Callatis, Tomis, Odessos), Olbia and Tyras, the Crimean coast, the Cretan cities, the Iberian coast cluster at 0 W 39 N (Hemeroskopeion on Cliopatria's shape, not on any page opened), Byzantium and the Propontis, Acarnania, Sinope. Counterparts 'undetermined (page silent)' stand for the unnamed new holder of the Carian cells. Gazetteer names needed: Laconia (region), Agde, Hyères, Antibes (places; the massalia dossier needs the same).
